reason: The cited handler sends a fixed browser_go_forward socket message and, because it is registered as goForward(true), returns captureAriaSnapshot output. The snapshot function returns the current page URL, title, and browser_snapshot content, which are web/page-controlled and therefore untrusted. The lines do not show arbitrary host code execution or delivery of agent-supplied data to an attacker-readable destination. They also do not establish that the returned page data is non-public/credentialed/local data, only that browser page data is returned.
